name: DiffSBDD
one_liner: SE(3)-equivariant 3D conditional diffusion model for structure-based drug design coupled with AutoDock Vina docking and evolutionary optimization.

loop.proposes: An SE(3)-equivariant diffusion model generates 3D ligand atom coordinates and types directly inside a target protein binding pocket.
loop.judged_by: RDKit chemical validity checks, synthetic accessibility (SA), QED drug-likeness, and AutoDock Vina / QuickVina2 physics docking score each ligand.
loop.steers: An evolutionary partial-noising and denoising loop mutates top-scoring ligands and selects candidates with higher binding affinity and QED.

headline_result: Generated pocket-specific 3D ligands with stronger Vina binding scores and drug-likeness than autoregressive 3D baselines on CrossDocked2020.
caveat: Rigid-pocket docking scores do not account for induced-fit protein conformational changes or explicit water bridges.
beyond_harness_note: An evolutionary docking loop drives an SE(3)-equivariant 3D molecular diffusion generator to optimize pocket binding affinity.
algorithmic_authority: RDKit chemical validator and QuickVina2 / AutoDock Vina physics docking oracle

sources.title: Structure-based drug design with equivariant diffusion models (Nature Computational Science, 2024)

verification.notes: Checked against Schneuing et al., Nature Computational Science 4, 2024. Year corrected 2023 to 2024 (Nature Computational Science 4, 2024-12) per the ledger.
